newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIA BEAT ESTONIA 2-0 TO BOOST CHANCES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIA BEAT ESTONIA 2-0 TO BOOST CHANCES.

text.p: Austria boosted their chances of reaching next year's World Cup finals with a hard-fought 2-0 victory over European group four opponents Estonia on Wednesday.
Scotland's 2-1 defeat in Sweden means the Austrians have closed to within four points of the Scots and have two matches in hand.
Croatian-born Ivica Vastic opened the scoring in Vienna's Happel stadium in the 48th minute after a pass from captain Anton Polster.
Vastic beat Estonian goalkeeper Mart Poom with a brilliant effort but then collided with Poom and had to be carried off with an injured leg.
With three minutes left, Vastic's substitute, Peter Stoeger, made it 2-0 after a cross from Werder Bremen's Andreas Herzog.
Austria had two early goals disallowed for offside but were largely in control although the Estonian defence stuck it out to the end.
